assessments.reasoning: The exact syntax guide explains the case/in pattern form and names NoMatchingPatternError for a value with no matching branch when else is absent. Its surrounding text distinguishes the standalone in and rightward-assignment forms and disallows mixing in with when.

challenge.method: Compare an unmatched case/in without else, a case/in with an else fallback, and the separate standalone pattern forms in the same guide.
challenge.results: The exception statement is conditional on zero matching branches and absence of else. Standalone boolean matching and rightward assignment do not broaden the documented case/in claim.

limitations: The claim concerns the documented no-match case/in condition. Exceptions during evaluation of a scrutinee, pattern method, or guard address another condition.
